AshoGhuri · Privacy

Your trip data, explained.

This page describes the current static-site version. It has no connected AshoGhuri account or server-side memory gallery.

What stays in this browser

  • Your profile is stored under ashoghuri-profile-v1.
  • Saved destinations are stored under asho-saved.
  • Tour-memory cards and compressed photos are stored under ashoghuri-memories-v1.
  • Language and theme preferences use asho-lang and ashoghuri-theme.

These are local browser-storage keys, not an online account. Clearing browser data, changing browser or device, or using private browsing can remove or hide this information. The Account page can clear the profile, saved trips and memories from this browser.

External services and media

  • The Safety weather tool sends the selected district to Open-Meteo geocoding and forecast services. It does not request device location. Forecasts are approximate; consult BMD warnings.
  • Destination photos may load from Wikimedia Commons or other credited image hosts. Opening source, booking, email or other external links takes you to that provider and its policies.
  • A budget quote and travel details are calculated in the page; this version does not send them to an AshoGhuri server.

Sharing and deletion

Tour memories are saved only on your device. They are not publicly posted or visible to other visitors. If you choose your device’s share action, the operating system or selected app handles what you share. Use Account → Clear local data to remove your saved profile, destination list and tour memories from this browser; language and theme choices remain.

Review

This notice describes the current prototype behavior and should be reviewed whenever storage, analytics, authentication, uploads or third-party providers change.
